penalties: #27 has been issued a formal warning and is on probation.  Please respect our culture, you can be the biggest jack ass on the mic but you need to respect other drivers regarding how your control your car.

incidents.desc: The #12 car over reacts to the #33 car getting into the wall and turns down aggressively causing the #28 to spin and lose control.  The #12, #28, and #33 cars are all collected.
incidents.ruling: #12 is at fault for this.  You need to take less breaks in iRacing so your skills stay sharp.

incidents.desc: On the restart #16 intentionally turns into the #27 causing them both to lose control and slide off the track.
incidents.ruling: Retaliation is never ok, however leading up to this the #27 car was constantly dooring and messing with the #16 through several turns unnecessarily.  This is an extreme example of having someone mess with you and in this case it's understandable the #16 car reacted the way they did.  It's NOT OK but it is understandable.  The #27 car is at fault here and has been issued a formal warning for trolling/harassment of other drivers.

incidents.desc: The #27 car fails to maintain speed, bounces off the wall several times and comes back down into traffic collecting the #6, #99
incidents.ruling: The #27 car is at fault here for failing to maintain the track pace and not being able to maintain control of their car.

incidents.desc: The #92 moves left to avoid a checkup on the wall, the #80 car does not react in time and drives through the #92 causing a wreck and collecting the #31 and #101 cars.
incidents.ruling: Racing incident, while the #80 car did drive into the #92, all of this happened pretty quickly and was a reaction to another car up the track checking up.

incidents.desc: The #23 car drives into the grass, gets loose, and comes back onto the track collecting both the #92, and #12
incidents.ruling: #23 why are you driving on the grass?  This is a warning.

incidents.desc: The #11 car attempts to go 3 wide in a very tight space however the #11 taps the #80 car's corner closing the hole on the #11.  The #80 car hits their 12x and is DQed.
incidents.ruling: #11 car is at fault, the #11 car attempted to fill a tight space but did not use up all their space they had on the right side first.

incidents.desc: The #93 comes down, the #57 comes up, they collide, get loose and hit the pit trash cans.
The #24 gets loose and turns into a pinball between the #20, #33, and eventually the #45
incidents.ruling: The #24 is at fault for getting loose, you can see the #24 car oscillating left/right before the first impact, maybe look into an oval rim or increasing your total degrees of rotation in your wheelbase software to help with stability.
